cause: Carried float32 error: PolicyEngine-US computes in float32, where one unit in the last place at this AGI ($255,108.89) is about 1.6 cents; its AGI (line 11b) and taxable income (line 15) are each 1 cent lower than the project's, within their own float bounds, and that cent moves its rate-schedule tax by 2 cents. Investigated 2026-10-18 when social security benefits entered the generated cases.
